mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `show` (name, description, category_id, city_code, address, poster_url, venue, status, extend, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{cityCode}, #{address}, #{posterUrl}, #{venue}, #{status}, #{extend,typeHandler=com.ticket.core.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `show` SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, city_code = #{cityCode}, address = #{address}, poster_url = #{posterUrl}, venue = #{venue}, status = #{status}, extend = #{extend,typeHandler=com.ticket.core.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, category_id, city_code, address, poster_url, venue, status, extend, create_time, update_time FROM `show` WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, description, category_id, city_code, address, poster_url, venue, status, extend, create_time, update_time FROM `show` ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, name, description, category_id, city_code, address, poster_url, venue, status, extend, create_time, update_time FROM `show` WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.category_id, s.city_code, s.address, s.poster_url, s.venue, s.status, s.extend, s.create_time, s.update_time, c.name AS category_name, ct.name AS city_name FROM `show` s LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN city ct ON ct.code = s.city_code WHERE s.id = #{id}

#{id}
